title: The Kerala Restriction on Transfer by and Restoration of Lands to Scheduled Tribes Act, 1999
full_text: The Kerala Restriction on Transfer by and Restoration of Lands to Scheduled Tribes Act, 1999 1999-ലെ കേരള പട്ടികവര്‍ഗ്ഗ ഭൂമി കൈമാറ്റ നിയന്ത്രണവും പുനരാവകാശ സ്ഥാപനവും ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 199912 Act Number: 12 Enactment Date: 1999-03-09 Act Year: 1999 Short Title: The Kerala Restriction on Transfer by and Restoration of Lands to Scheduled Tribes Act, 1999 Hindi Title: 1999-ലെ കേരള പട്ടികവര്‍ഗ്ഗ ഭൂമി കൈമാറ്റ നിയന്ത്രണവും പുനരാവകാശ സ്ഥാപനവും ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to provide for restricting the transfer of lands by members of Scheduled Tribes in the State of Kerala and for the Restoration of possession of lands alienated by such members and for matters connected therewith.
